actionable_steps: Build the Rank-1 target list now: `Catalogs.query_criteria(catalog='Tic', d=[0,50], Tmag=[13.5,16], Teff=[2300,3900], objType='STAR', lumclass='DWARF')` (6,196 stars; file tic_mdwarfs_100pc_faint.csv already holds the 100-pc version with 100,567 rows); drop TOI/CTOI hosts (33/43) and Kostov-2025 EBs.

For every target, inventory public products with lightkurve (authors SPOC, TESS-SPOC, QLP, TGLC, TARS, GSFC-ELEANOR-LITE, T16) guarding masked sequence_number values, then fill coverage gaps with TESScut 200-s cutout photometry (aperture + PRF-weighted) for all sectors through 107, so each star has a uniform multi-sector light curve.
Run injection-recovery on ~300 TARS light curves to decide whether unpopular-CPM detrending preserves 0.1-1% transits before using TARS as a search product.

Search with wotan biweight + TLS/BLS over 0.5-30 d with transit durations down to 0.5 h (SPOC's FFI DV minimum is 2 h), require >=3 events, and run matched inverted-flux and sector-shuffled nulls on every star; log pass counts for real vs null as Kuber and eumemic did.

Pixel-localise every survivor (per-sector difference images and flux-weighted centroids vs Gaia DR3 neighbours), then run TRICERATOPS with MOLUSC Gaia-limited companions; budget for ~90% rejection at the pixel stage.

Set up a standing monthly job for the TOI-lag window: on each MAST release (24-39 d after sector end) download `tesscurl_sector_N_dv.sh` and `_lc.sh`, cross-match the new SPOC TCEs against TOI (TAP `toi`) and CTOI (ExoFOP CSV), and search T>13.5 stars yourself; S108 is expected ~early Nov 2026 and S109 ~early Dec 2026. Skip QLP S99-104 until MAST redelivers.

Optionally run the Rank-3 Kepler Bonus non-M pool: use kbonus/kbonus_nonM_background_survivors.csv (25,542 stars; restrict to G<16 -> 6,151), download their KBONUS-BKG light curves (author 'KBONUS-BKG'), apply the 25%-holdout BLS pipeline with inverted nulls and per-quarter dilution tests, and publish as a catalogue quickly; email the Moquin/Wilson/Quintana poster authors first to avoid duplicating TraSHDUMP.

Before any novelty claim, cross-match against: KOI cumulative + DR25 TCE + fpwg, Villanova Kepler EBs (2,878), k2pandc (4,077), pscomppars (6,451), TOI (8,151) + CTOI (5,138), Prsa 2022 TESS EBs (4,584), Kostov 2025 (10,001 + ~900k unvetted), T16 Planet Hunt (11,554), Kunimoto 2022 (1,617), DTARPS (J/AJ/167/203), Gaia DR3 vari tables and NSS, SIMBAD otype, and any membership/target lists (Barber 2022-type) for the star.
After 2026-12-02, cross-match candidates against Gaia DR4 `vari_planetary_transit` (1,007 rows) and pull DR4 epoch photometry via DataLink to extend ephemerides and check for blended variability.
Do not spend compute on Kepler primary targets, Kepler/K2 superstamps, Gaia-only or ground-survey-only transit searches; use ZTF/ATLAS/ASAS-SN forced photometry and Gaia only as vetting inputs.
